items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: I knew Drew's mother and his sister and things, but I don't know anything anymore. I never visited him, you know, that much.

ctx.x: You mentioned you knew the family of Mr. Bowman. I wonder if you could tell us anything more about that. Oh, Lord. I knew Drew's mother and his sister and things, but I don't know anything anymore. I never visited him, you know, that much. And that was right after Buddy lost his mind and they put him in. I used to talk to his sister. Yeah. After Buddy was gone. Yeah, after all that, after he was gone or something like that. Because they knew my mother-in-law well. Mother lived in the same neighborhood once before…
Do you know anything about Raymond Brown that was George's bosom buddy? That little George.
